name: 🌈 Chill Rainbow Tower Obby (400+ Levels)
desc:
🌈 Climb 400+ colorful stages in the most chill tower on Roblox! Easy, relaxing, and satisfying to complete.

🎧 Play it your way:
• 🗣️ Talk with friends while you climb
• 📺 Play while watching YouTube or TV
• 🎶 Listen to music while you play
• 😎 Just have fun at your own speed


How to Play:
• 🌈 Complete Satisfying stages & earn rubies
• 💎 Prestige for rewards & flex
• 🐾 Unlock pets & cosmetics
• 💾 Progress saves automatically

Can you clear all 400 stages?
